activity.notes: After the death of his father Piero in December 1469, Lorenzo de' Medici accepted responsibility for the city and state while formally remaining a private citizen and became the effective political leader of Florence until his death in 1492. ATLAS therefore records de facto governance of the Republic of Florence rather than inventing a princely or monarchical office.

sources.title: Lorenzo de' Medici, detto il Magnifico — Treccani
sources.citation_text: Treccani states that after his father's death in 1469 Lorenzo became the true lord of Florence while formally remaining a private citizen and held that position until his death in 1492.
